title: Bind production qualification to offline pinned shipped-dependency advisory evidence
acceptance: Production qualification checks the root native normal/build dependency graph with no default features and no dev dependencies, before compilation. Pin a clean approved RustSec Git revision and bind its tree/content, unchanged policy, scanner version and executable digest to manifest-hashed receipts. Reject missing, dirty, mismatched, wrong-origin, stale/future, modified and advisory-failing inputs. Preserve all existing license, build, test, inference, health and package checks; advance qualification policy so older licenses-only receipts do not imply advisory clearance.

provisioning.SUSI_RELEASE_ADVISORY_DB: Path to a clean agent-provisioned RustSec checkout; no network fetch in qualifier
provisioning.freshness: Commit timestamp maximum seven days old, maximum five minutes future skew
provisioning.authentication: Caller authenticates provisioning; offline gate checks configured standard HTTPS origin, revision, tree and bytes and does not claim remote authentication

validation.fixture_scope: New advisory negative regression uses an explicitly fabricated test-only database and real cargo-deny. No fixture receipt is product qualification.
validation.production: Pending combined integration and real product requalification; no promotion or waiver.
commands: cargo clippy -p xtask --features release-tooling --bin local-release --tests --offline --locked -- -D warnings
